title: Breastfeeding Indicators
text: Children less 24 months ever breastfed defined follows: \[ \text{Ever breastfed} = \frac{\text{Children}_{\text{age < 24 months}} \text{ever breastfed}}{\text{Children}_{\text{age < 24 months}}} \] indicator can calculated using get_evbf() function follows: Two input parameters needed calculate indicator: (1) child’s age months; , (2) child ever breastfed . Checking whether correct: Among , 108 breastfeeding, 45 didn’t. Therefore, get_evbf() function yields result manual check, can go ahead use reporting purposes.
code: df <- within(iycfData, {   evbf <- get_evbf(q4 = child_bf, age = calc_age_months) })  table(df$evbf) #>  #>   0   1  #>   7 145 evbf <- with(   df,    ifelse(     calc_age_months < 24 & child_bf == 1, 1,     ifelse(calc_age_months < 24 & child_bf == 0, 0, NA)   ) )  table(evbf) #> evbf #>   0   1  #>   7 145 length(which(df$calc_age_months < 24 & df$child_bfyest == 1)) #> [1] 108 length(which(df$calc_age_months < 24 & df$child_bfyest == 0)) #> [1] 45

what: Introduction of solid, semi-solid, or soft foods for 6-8 month old children
title: Complementary Feeding Indicators - Other
text: introduction semi-solid food indicator accounts 6-8 months old children receive solid (semi-solid food) previous day. , don’t use self-reported variable “number meal frequency” feeding calculation. Instead, use dietary recall variables IYCF sample question Question 7A Question 7R. children received one food items questions, children considered introduced solid, semi-solid, soft food (ISSF). Use get_dummy() function create dummy variable solid food consumption solid food diet recall questions. , use get_isssf() function get number children meet indicator definition .
code: df <- iycfData  solid <- list(   df$child_rice, df$child_potatoes, df$child_pumpkin, df$child_beans,    df$child_leafyveg, df$child_mango, df$child_fruit, df$child_organ,    df$child_beef, df$child_fish, df$child_processmeat, df$child_eggs,    df$child_yogurt, df$child_sweets )  df$solid_food <- get_dummy(var_list = solid) df$isssf <- get_isssf(solid_food = df$solid_food,                        age = df$calc_age_months) table(df$isssf) #>  #>  0  1  #>  3 24

what: Egg and/or flesh food consumption for 6-23 month old children
title: Complementary Feeding Indicators - Other
text: Another indicator related complementary feeding consumption egg /flesh food, accounts 6-23 months children get eggs /flesh food previous day. can use get_dummy() create dummy variable indicate got food . According guidelines, following questions considered sweet beverage foods category. Question 7I: Liver, kidney, heart Question 7J: Sausages, hot dogs, ham, bacon, salami, canned meat Question 7K: meat, beef, pork, lamb, goat, chicken, duck Question 7L: Eggs Question 7M: Fresh fish, dried fish shellfish , using get_eff calculate EFF indicator using dummy variable created child age variable.
code: egg_meat <- list(df$child_organ, df$child_beef, df$child_fish, df$child_processmeat, df$child_eggs)  df$egg_meat <- get_dummy(var_list = egg_meat) df$eff <- get_eff(egg_meat = df$egg_meat,                    age = df$calc_age_months) table(df$eff) #>  #>  0  1  #> 38 75

what: Sweet beverage consumption for 6-23 month old children
title: Complementary Feeding Indicators - Other
text: can use Sweet Beverage Consumption indicator identify children get sweet beverage food previous day. Like indicators complementary feeding indicator, use get_dummy() identify children get types food, calculate specific indicator “SwB” using get_swb(). According guideline, following questions considered sweet beverage foods category. Question 6Cswt: Milk animals - sweet flavoured type milk Question 6Dswt: Yogurt drinks - sweet flavoured type yogurt Question 6E: Chocolate-flavoured drinks Question 6F: Fruit juice fruit-flavoured drinks Question 6G: Sodas, malt drinks, sports drinks energy drinks Question 6Hswt: Tea, coffee, herbal drinks - sweetened Question 6Jswt: liquids - sweetened
code: sweet <- list(   df$child_milk_sweet, df$child_mproduct_sweet, df$child_chocolate, df$child_juice, df$child_soda,  df$child_tea_sweet, df$child_oth_drink_sweet )  df$sweet <- get_dummy(var_list = sweet)  df$swb <- get_swb(sweet = df$sweet,                    age = df$calc_age_months) table(df$swb) #> < table of extent 0 >

what: Unhealthy food consumption for 6-23 month old children
title: Complementary Feeding Indicators - Other
text: According definition, indicator account two types foods diet recall; Question 7P (sentinel sweet foods) Question 7Q (sentinel fried salty foods). using get_dummy() function create dummy variable, indicates whether child took food previous day . , can use get_ufc() function calculate indicator.
code: unhealthy <- list(df$child_sweets, df$child_snack)  df$unhealthy <- get_dummy(var_list = unhealthy)  df$ufc <- get_ufc(unhealthy = df$unhealthy,                    age = df$calc_age_months) table(df$ufc) #>  #>   0   1  #>  12 101

what: Zero vegetable or fruit consumption for 6-23 month old children
title: Complementary Feeding Indicators - Other
text: indicator calculates 6-23 months children consume vegetables fruits previous day. Using list vegetables fruits questions diet recall module (questions), can use get_dummy() function calculate dummy variable. , apply variable get_zvf() get number children consume vegetables fruits previous day. According guideline, fruit vegetable questions list recommended follows. However, survey complete list questions (variables), apply relevant indicator definition. Questions 7C: Vitamin -rich yellow/orange vegetables Questions 7E: Dark green leafy vegetables Questions 7F: vegetables Questions 7G: Vitamin -rich fruits Questions 7H: fruits

title: WHO IYCF Questionnaire XLS Forms
text: Based form structure approach questionnaire administration, four types IYCF form. Open recall questionnaire Food consumption questions administered asking respondent child ate meal time yesterday morning child woke night child went sleep. List-based questionnaire approach directly asks respondent whether child ate individual food groups mentioned questionnaire. approaches contain questions difference display format based questionnaire’s approach administration. two approaches described detail page 28 IYCF indicator guidelines. IYCF forms XLSForm standard can found GitHub repository. hhsvy_iycf_open_recall - IYCF questionnaire module within household survey using open recall approach hhsvy_iycf_list_based - IYCF questionnaire module within household survey using list-based approach iycf_list_based - IYCF questionnaire module using open recall approach iycf_open_recall - IYCF questionnaire module using list-based approach

title: Minimum Diet Related Indicators
text: Calculation MDD included three main steps: (1) identification food groups consumed children 6-23 months age previous days, (2) calculation total number food groups (total 8 food groups) consumed previous day (3) identification children meet minimum requirement food groups (least 5 food groups) previous day’s consumption.

previous_headings: Minimum Diet Related Indicators > Minimum Dietary Diversity 6-23 Months (MDD)
what: Individual food group consumption: dummy variables
title: Minimum Diet Related Indicators
text: first step MDD, now identify food group children consumed previous day. use get_dummy function generate dummy variable 8 food groups: breast milk; grains, white/pale starchy roots, tubers plantains; beans, peas, lentils, nuts seeds; dairy products (milk, infant formula, yogurt, cheese); flesh foods (meat, fish, poultry, organ meats); eggs; vitamin -rich fruits vegetables; fruits vegetables. Please note input parameter get_dummy function list, vector. need prepare list variables food items like include food group dummy variable calculation. article, used variables applied 2021 IYCF indicators guideline. detailed description input variables used food group calculation can checked using following syntax sample dataset description file. breastfeeding dummy variable, guideline-recommended using Question  4: breastfed yesterday day night. grains-related food groups, including grains, white/pale starchy roots, tubers plantains, used Question 7B Question 7D IYCF sample questionnaires. pulses food groups include beans, peas, lentils, nuts, seeds, need use one variable, Question 7N. dairy products food group, following foods items included; milk, infant formula, yogurt, cheese) following questions guidelines provide information; Question 6B, Question 6C, Question 6D, Question 7A, Question 7O. information flesh foods, meat, fish, poultry, organ meats, available following four questions guideline; Question 7I, Question 7J, Question 7K, Question 7M. one variable requires Eggs food group, Question 7L. use following questions guideline calculating vitamin -rich fruits vegetables; Question 7C, Question 7E, Question 7G. used following two variables fruits vegetable food groups; Question 7F Question 7H.
code: ?iycfData df <- iycfData  df$breastmilk <- get_dummy(var_list = list(df$child_bfyest)) df$grains <- get_dummy(var_list = list(df$child_rice, df$child_potatoes)) df$pulses <- get_dummy(var_list = list(df$child_beans)) dairy_list <- list(df$child_bms, df$child_milk, df$child_mproduct, df$child_yogurt, df$child_yogurt)  df$dairy <- get_dummy(var_list = dairy_list) meat_list <- list(df$child_organ, df$child_insects,  df$child_beef, df$child_fish)  df$meat <- get_dummy(var_list = meat_list) df$eggs <- get_dummy(var_list = list(df$child_eggs)) vita_fruveg_list <- list(df$child_pumpkin, df$child_leafyveg, df$child_mango)  df$vita_fruveg <- get_dummy(var_list = vita_fruveg_list) df$oth_fruveg <- get_dummy(var_list = list(df$child_fruit, df$child_fruit))

title: Minimum Diet Related Indicators
text: , can now calculate total food group score children consumed previous day. use individual food group variables calculation.
code: df$food_score <- get_foodscore(breastmilk = df$breastmilk,                                 grains = df$grains,                                 pulses = df$pulses,                                 dairy = df$dairy,                                 meat = df$meat,                                 eggs = df$eggs,                                 vita_fruveg = df$vita_fruveg,                                 oth_fruveg = df$oth_fruveg) table(df$food_score) #>  #>  0  1  2  3  4  5  6  7  8  #>  3 30 32 43 28 18  3  4  1 summary(df$food_score) #>    Min. 1st Qu.  Median    Mean 3rd Qu.    Max.     NAs  #>   0.000   2.000   3.000   2.957   4.000   8.000     197

title: Minimum Diet Related Indicators
text: Finally, can calculate indicators minimum dietary diversity, identified children 6-23 months get least 5 food groups previous day’s diet.
code: df$mdd <- get_mdd(food_score = df$food_score,                    age = df$calc_age_months) table(df$mdd) #>  #>  0  1  #> 87 26

title: Minimum Diet Related Indicators
text: Unlike MDD, MMF requires complex criteria, depend children breastfeeding status age range. need four essential information calculate indicator; child age, breastfeeding status, meal frequency, milk (beside breastmilk) feeding frequency.

previous_headings: Minimum Diet Related Indicators > Minimum Meal Frequency 6-23 Months (MMF)
title: Minimum Diet Related Indicators
text: minimum meal frequency breastfeeding varies child’s age. requires least two meals 6-8 months old children, least three times children 9-23 months old. sample syntax using three functions calculate minimum meal frequency breastfeeding children. get_mmf_bf_6to8 - calculate minimum meal frequency 6-8 months old breastfed children get_mmf_bf_9to23 - calculate minimum meal frequency 6-8 months old breastfed children get_mmf_bf - calculate minimum meal frequency 6-8 months old breastfed children
code: # BF 6-8 months  df$mmfbf_6to8 <- get_mmf_bf_6to8(q4 = df$child_bfyest,                                   q8 = df$child_food_freq,                                   age = df$calc_age_months) table(df$mmfbf_6to8) #>  #>  0  1  #>  7 14  # BF 9-23 months  df$mmfbf_9to23 <- get_mmf_bf_9to23(q4 = df$child_bfyest,                                     q8 = df$child_food_freq,                                     age = df$calc_age_months)  table(df$mmfbf_9to23) #>  #>  0  1  #> 24 28  # Overall BF df$mmf_bf <- get_mmf_bf(mmfbf_6to8 = df$mmfbf_6to8,                          mmfbf_9to23 = df$mmfbf_9to23) table(df$mmf_bf) #>  #>  0  1  #> 31 42

previous_headings: Minimum Diet Related Indicators > Minimum Meal Frequency 6-23 Months (MMF)
title: Minimum Diet Related Indicators
text: MMF calculation non-breastfeeding children, need consider number milk feeds meal frequency. get , use get_nonbf_frq function calculate milk & meal feeding frequency using following questions; Question 6Bnum: infant formula feeding frequency, Question 6Cnum: animal milk feeding frequency, Question 6Dnum: milk-product liquid feeding frequency Question 8: meal frequency. , calculate minimum meal frequency 6-23 months non-breastfeeding children using milk & meal frequency information calculate . Whoever gets least 4-times milk meal frequency previous identified children get minimum meal frequency non-breastfed children. Use get_mmf_nonbf function calculate indicator sample syntax provided .
code: df$nonbf_frq <- get_nonbf_frq(q6bnum = df$child_bms_freq,                                q6cnum = df$child_milk_freq,                                q6dnum = df$child_mproduct_freq,                                q8 = df$child_food_freq)  table(df$nonbf_frq) #> < table of extent 0 > sum(df$nonbf_frq) #> [1] NA df$mmf_nonbf <- get_mmf_nonbf(q4 = df$child_bfyest,                                 q8 = df$child_food_freq,                                nonbf_frq = df$nonbf_frq,                                age = df$calc_age_months) table(df$mmf_nonbf) #> < table of extent 0 >

previous_headings: Minimum Diet Related Indicators > Minimum Meal Frequency 6-23 Months (MMF)
title: Minimum Diet Related Indicators
text: calculating minimum meal frequency breastfed non-breastfed children separately, use get_mmf function consolidate one overall minimum meal frequency indicator reporting. also frequently report indicator aggregated figure breastfeeding status age range (breastfed children). Therefore, immediate variables created along path calculate overall MMF indicator also helpful reporting work.
code: df$mmf <- get_mmf(mmf_bf = df$mmf_bf,                    mmf_nonbf = df$mmf_nonbf) table(df$mmf) #>  #>  0  1  #> 31 42

what: Minimum Milk Feeding Frequency For Non-Breastfed Children 6-23 Months (MMFF)
title: Minimum Diet Related Indicators
text: minimum milk feeding frequency indicator non-breastfeeding children. requires two-stage calculations; (1) calculating milk feeding frequency score (2) calculating MMFF indicator. package, can use get_milk_frq function get score, following input information required score; Question 6Bnum: infant formula feeding frequency, Question 6Cnum: animal milk feeding frequency, Question 6Dnum: milk product liquid feeding frequency, Question 7Anum: milk-product solid food feeding frequency. Whoever 6-23 months old non-breastfed children get least two milk feeds previous day considered minimally milk-fed children. text: first 1,000 days life (pregnancy child’s 2nd birthday) critical addressing childhood malnutrition, especially stunting. Infant young child feeding practices (IYCF) largely overlap period cover breastfeeding complementary feeding practices first two years child’s life. also significant impact childhood health, nutrition outcomes, child survival. , therefore, critical countries measure IYCF practices part efforts monitor progress toward Sustainable Development Goal 2. also important development agencies able monitor evaluate programs aimed improving infant young child feeding practices towards improved overall childhood nutrition.
